notes:
New in 2.75:
• Measuring Blocks is back on the controller menu — menus now match the Play Store version (Data Log, Adaptation, Output Tests, Login, Recode included)
• Glow plug lamp under the Dash Panel gauges — shows post-glow after startup too; demo mode now simulates a real glow cycle in group 012
• Throttle Body Align and Steering Angle Cal. removed from the menu
• EDC15 Multimap Bank
• EDC16 RAM Dump
• Engine protocol picker (Auto / EDC15 / EDC16) with EDC16 auto-fallback on connect
• Pair Bluetooth devices from inside the app (ELM327 PIN 1234 auto-filled)
• Generic Bluetooth dash with 8 live gauges; dash voltage fix
• Comms Debug button back on the Connect screen
